chapters.index: One thread per number, 10,000 at once

description:
Your first CUDA kernel runs at under 1% of the GPU's peak. The same matrix multiply, rewritten chapter by chapter, gets to 78%. This is how, as a song.

Every scene follows a chapter of CUDA for Deep Learning: threads and the index, warps and divergence, coalescing, shared-memory tiles, tensor cores, flash attention, quantization, many GPUs. The numbers are the book's measured ones on an RTX 3090 (the matmul climbing from 0.3 to 27.8 TFLOPS of a 35.6 TFLOPS peak), drawn over a model of an H100.

{chapters}

Made with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5): lyrics, the song (ACE-Step 1.5), word alignment, every scene (three.js), the render. Renderer forked from mexicat's p(doom) video (MIT).

#CUDA #GPU #MachineLearning
